$comment: Gate B DRAFT rule object for RF-SEV-002 — pending, NON-EXECUTABLE. Authored only from RF Clinical Rule Specification v1.2 §9.3 and the RF-SEV-002 inventory entry. Clinical-content-only rule: cites evidence claims and has NO architecture references (architecture_refs intentionally empty per v1.2 §4.3). Expresses classification/context STRUCTURE that SEPARATES BAMIC ontology (evidence_record_only) from MRI-confirmed RF outcome context (bounded logic_with_uncertainty). BAMIC ontology is stored only from a valid report/verified assessment and never inferred; MRI-confirmed outcome may only widen group-level uncertainty in a small elite track-and-field cohort. No autonomous prognosis engine, fixed timeline, severity conversion, recurrence score, raw-media interpretation, phase selection, rehab, dosage, progression, confidence, or return-to-sport logic; safety precedence preserved. Not approved. Not wired into any runtime.
rule_title: Separate BAMIC ontology from MRI-confirmed RF outcome context

input_contract.$comment: Structural classification inputs taken verbatim-in-meaning from v1.2 §9.3. BAMIC ontology is stored only when validly supplied; MRI-confirmed outcome context is bounded to the source cohort. Raw media is never interpreted here.

decision_contract.$comment: Classification/context structure only, with the BAMIC ontology and MRI-confirmed outcome roles kept separate. BAMIC ontology is evidence-record-only; MRI-confirmed outcome is bounded group-level context that may only widen uncertainty. No prognosis engine, no fixed timeline, no severity conversion, no recurrence score, no raw-media interpretation, no phase/rehab/plan/RTS, no numeric values. Safety precedence preserved.

notes: Clinical_content normative source; MAY. Dual/contextual permitted_use in the body: evidence_record_only for the BAMIC ontology; logic_with_uncertainty for bounded RF outcome context — the inventory/object record the primary permitted_use (logic_with_uncertainty) and the dual roles are captured structurally in decision_contract (bamic_ontology_role / mri_confirmed_outcome_role). Architecture references are intentionally empty: per v1.2 §4.3 clinical-content rules cite valid evidence_claim_ids and do not carry architecture refs (none in §9.3); [] means 'none in source', not 'missing'. Evidence roles and grades preserved per source: QRF-009 (E1; ontology only — not decision-driving prognosis), QRF-040 (D2), QRF-041 (D3) bounded to the small elite track-and-field MRI-confirmed context; QRF-010 is NOT used as authority for BAMIC outcomes. Per §9.3 ontology logic: store a BAMIC grade/class only when supplied by a valid report or verified assessment; do not infer it from mechanism, symptoms, or self-test results. Per §9.3 outcome logic: in a small elite track-and-field cohort, valid MRI-confirmed grade/class may widen group-level return-to-full-training or repeat-injury uncertainty only. Limits preserved exactly: no precise individual timeline, no automatic severity conversion, no deterministic recurrence score, and no universal rehabilitation change. Raw media (MRI/ultrasound/DICOM/screenshots/image files/photos/videos) is not interpreted here and requires a separately validated imaging subsystem (V3.1 §25); BAMIC ontology is not authority for media-source handling. Uncertainty is preserved when classification source quality is weak, absent, user-entered without source, unclear, or not MRI-confirmed as required. Severity rule, not a safety rule, so safety_state_output is null and blocked_targets is empty; safety precedence preserved. No severity/prognosis model is authored here (deferred to the later severity and readiness objects). Draft — approval_status remains pending.
